notes: Adds new files under src/Playnite.Core/Addons without editing the p3-005 parser, fixtures or manifest tests. AddonManifestValidator reuses ManifestSerialization read-only against tests/golden/manifests and tests/fixtures/manifests-v10, restores the v10 default GenericPlugin only when the oracle-captured extension manifest omits Type, and returns stable per-case diagnostics with the offending member path. AddonInstallLayout defines the deterministic Extensions/<id>/<version> target, rejects an id, version, module or icon that is absolute or escapes the directory, and AddonInstaller installs a validated unpacked package, rejects duplicate ids, manifest/version mismatches and package symlinks, and removes the whole id directory on uninstall with a residue check. The installed extension.yaml and module stay under the recursive discovery root used by v10 ExtensionFactory and the p6-009 IPlayniteExtension host contract. No store, network, download, update or package execution path.
